newsitem.title: USA: FDA clears Kos NIASPAN drug for sale.
newsitem.headline: FDA clears Kos NIASPAN drug for sale.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted clearance for Kos Pharmaceuticals Inc to market the drug NIASPAN to treat mixed lipid disorders in the treatment of second heart attacks and, when combined with bile-binding resins, to promote regression of atherosclerosis, Kos said Tuesday.
Kos internally developed NIASPAN and retains worldwide marketing rights.

The company said it is ready to launch the drug promptly and has more than 85 sales representatives committed to join its sales organization effective August 1. It said it expects to begin detailing NIASPAN to healthcare professionals before the end of this quarter.
Kos is engaged in the development of prescription pharmaceuticals for the treatment of certain chronic cardiovascular and respiratory diseases.
